description: Step 1 of 2 for submitting a product to Makeroo on the maker's behalf. Only submit what you verified from the product's repo or site. Validates the details and returns a preview plus a confirmationToken. Stores and emails nothing. Show the maker the preview and the recipient email, and only after they explicitly confirm call confirm_submission.

description.description: Plain description of what it does, 20-2000 chars

logoUrl.description: Public http(s) URL of a logo

makerEmail.description: Contact email of the maker; receives a confirm link once confirm_submission runs

openSource.description: Whether the product is open source, only if verified; omit when unsure

platforms.description: Platforms it runs on; api_cli covers APIs, SDKs and CLIs; omit when unsure

pricing.description: Pricing model, only if verified; omit when unsure

repoUrl.description: Public GitHub, GitLab or Codeberg repo of an open-source product

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the product

title: Submit listing
